targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @logStream
| filter @logStream = "access-i-0576742bcb4121640"
| stats count(*) / 60 as V1_Staging_RPS by bin(1m)

fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream
| filter @logStream = "access-i-0576742bcb4121640"
| parse @message /"[^"]*" (?<status>[0-9]{3}) /
| filter status like /^4[0-9][0-9]$/
| stats count(*) as errors by bin(1m)

fields @timestamp, @logStream
| filter @logStream = "access-i-0576742bcb4121640"
| stats count(*) / 60 as rps by bin(1m)

fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream
| filter @logStream = "access-i-0576742bcb4121640"
| parse @message /"[^"]*" (?<status>[0-9]{3}) /
| filter status like /^5[0-9][0-9]$/
| stats count(*) as V1_5xx by bin(1m)
